cues.text: January 2026. Mayon rises to Alert Level 3.
cues.onscreen: Mayon smokes on the right; a house and a family of four on the left; the badge "ALERT LEVEL 3" drops in under "January 2026".

cues.text: A family in the danger zone packs one bag and asks one question.
cues.onscreen: A packed bag appears beside the family; a dotted path leaves the house toward the lowlands.

cues.text: Where do we go, and will there be room for Lola?
cues.onscreen: Speech bubble "Where do we go?", then "Room for Lola?" over the grandmother with a cane.

cues.text: The nearest shelter is a school, and it is already full.
cues.onscreen: A school at the end of the path fills window by window; a red stamp "FULL" lands on it.

cues.text: Zoom out to the whole province.
cues.onscreen: Albay as a field of 720 barangay dots in 18 towns; the danger zone glows around Mayon.

cues.text: In January, four schools turned into evacuation centers, and 3,424 learners were affected.
cues.onscreen: Card: "4 schools became evacuation centers · 3,424 learners affected" (counter), source line Philippine Daily Inquirer, 2026.

cues.text: By May, 34 classrooms in Camalig were sheltering about 1,315 people.
cues.onscreen: A grid of 34 classroom tiles fills; "34 classrooms · 488 families · about 1,315 people", source Daily Tribune, 2026.

cues.text: Sustainable Development Goal 4 asks for safe places to learn. Goal 11 asks us to protect people from disasters.
cues.onscreen: Chips slide in: "SDG 4.a · safe places to learn" and "SDG 11.5 · protect people from disasters".

cues.text: In Albay, both goals meet in the same classroom.
cues.onscreen: Both chips glide to the centre and meet over one classroom; RA 10821: "schools are a last resort" appears below.

cues.text: Then the alert rises, and minutes start to matter.
cues.onscreen: Badge changes to "ALERT LEVEL 4"; a clock counts minutes.

cues.text: Heavy rain sends lahar down the river channels and closes the bridges.
cues.onscreen: Two brown lahar channels cut across the road ring; bridges A1 to A4 and B1 to B3 turn red with a cross.

cues.text: Send everyone to the nearest site, and families arrive at shelters that are already full.
cues.onscreen: Arrows from every barangay to its nearest shelter; overflow counter "298 arrive at full shelters" (test network).

cues.text: So how do we shelter everyone, the vulnerable first, while keeping the most classrooms open?
cues.onscreen: Three lines build: "Everyone sheltered · Vulnerable first · Classrooms last" with a question mark.

cues.text: This is where MCS comes into play.
cues.onscreen: The letters M, C and S drop in, then unfold into Mathematical, Computational, Sciences.

cues.text: Mathematics turns open data into a road graph, with travel times, capacities, and shelters in three tiers.
cues.onscreen: Chain lights "Open data → Graph"; panel MATHEMATICS: test network E1 draws in; G = (N, E), τ_e, u_e; tiers: non-school, school open space, classrooms (18 per room).

cues.text: The law's order becomes one lexicographic minimum-cost flow: vulnerable first, then everyone, then classrooms last.
cues.onscreen: Lexicographic objective and the penalties M_O and M_Y; evacuee flows animate from O1 to O3 into their shelters (Alert Level 3 plan).

cues.text: Computing solves it exactly in seconds, and a time-expanded network gives the exact clearance time.
cues.onscreen: Chain lights "Algorithm → Numbers"; panel COMPUTING: copies of the road network per minute; arrival curve F(T) climbs to 1,560; T* = 53 min, lower bound 34.

cues.text: Optimisation sites new Ligtas Pinoy Centers, and the greedy rule is guaranteed at least sixty-three percent of the best.
cues.onscreen: Chain lights "Optimisation"; panel OPTIMISATION: f(S_g) ≥ (1 − 1/e) f(S*) ≈ 0.632 f(S*); the south town lights inside the lahar pocket: 400 of 450 sheltered.

cues.text: On the test network, the plan closes fourteen classrooms instead of forty, for under two minutes more travel.
cues.onscreen: Counters: classrooms closed 40 → 14; learners displaced 1,702 → 532; extra mean trip +1.70 min. Label "test network E1 (synthetic)".

cues.text: Ten results, proven, then verified against independent code.
cues.onscreen: Chain lights "Proof"; ten proof squares turn into green checks; 300/300 plans, 660/660 networks, 4,796 checks, 0 violations.

cues.text: LIGTA-S will not build one more shelter.
cues.onscreen: Boom. Screen darkens; the line appears in white.

cues.text: But when the alert rises, it will tell every family where to go, and keep the most classrooms open.
cues.onscreen: The line appears in gold.

cues.text: [pause] Distance tells you where the shelter is. A plan tells you if there is room, in time.
cues.onscreen: Two lines: "Distance tells you where the shelter is." (white), then "A plan tells you if there is room, in time." (gold).
